title: Inspect the ragged cloth
notes: Opt into WAR_RAGGED_CLOTH_DETAIL=1 to preview finer woven fibres, worn colour and matte cloth highlights on the existing ragged base. Ordinary launches keep the current material.
Fixed front, rear and gameplay captures compare the real garment with a flat-material control, so its surface can be judged close up.
The rigid flap shape, thick belt, rear opening and missing drape, seams and fraying remain below the reference. This preview does not clear the clothing or Phase 0 art gate.
